theater: 亞美尼亞高原與卡帕多細亞

battle.name: 第一次波斯-突厥戰爭
battle.theater: 亞美尼亞高原與卡帕多細亞
battle.brief: 公元588年起，薩珊波斯為爭奪亞美尼亞與高加索邊界，兵臨特拉比松與卡帕多細亞，與拜占庭在亞美尼亞高原拉鋸兩年，591年野戰失利才退兵議和。卡面的科林斯青銅盔出自公元前七世紀希臘，六世紀早已退出戰列；這場戰爭說明，能守住邊疆的是堡壘與投射兵器，不是一整面青銅。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 這場在中文的戰爭列表裡被記作「第一次波斯-突厥戰爭」的衝突，實際上發生在薩珊波斯與拜占庭帝國之間，斷代一般記為587至591年，戰爭列表把起點標為公元588年。波斯一方是霍爾米茲德四世與其子科斯勞二世統治下的薩珊帝國，國王直轄呼羅珊與美索不達米亞的常備軍，以重裝騎兵團「斯帕赫貝丹」為骨幹；高加索與外高加索一線靠附庸國度維持，亞美尼亞諸公國與伊比里亞王國聽命於波斯王庭，薩珊在北線還有西突厥汗國與裏海西岸哈扎爾部落的盟軍與傭兵，而它同時正與突厥爭奪河中與突騎施方向的地盤。拜占庭一方是東羅馬皇帝摩里斯的國家，軍隊由君士坦丁堡的禁軍與兵營軍、各軍區的野戰軍以及亞美尼亞軍區的駐軍組成，亞美尼亞王瓦罕的私軍、來自伊比里亞與拉茲的阿蘭人與拉茲人傭軍都在皇帝與軍區長官的調度下作戰。拜占庭把整場戰爭視為高加索與亞美尼亞邊界的生存之戰，核心考量是保住安條克防線與幼發拉底河上游那串橫跨山口的堡壘群；對薩珊而言，這是保住「外高加索屏障」與亞美尼亞宗主權的北向擴張，兩邊都明白輸掉邊界比輸掉戰役代價更大。
countriesEn: This conflict, listed in Chinese sources under the name of the First Persian-Turkic War, was in fact fought between the Sasanian Empire and the Byzantine Empire; its span is normally given as 587 to 591, while the war list marks its opening in 588 CE. On the Persian side stood the Sasanian state under Hormizd IV and his son Khosrow II, with the king's own field army drawn from Khurasan and Mesopotamia and the heavy cavalry corps known as the spahbedan as its core striking force. The Caucasus and Transcaucasia were held through client kingship: the Armenian principalities and the Iberian kingdom obeyed the Sasanian court, and in the northern theatre Persia also had the West Turkic Khaganate and Khazar bands from the western Caspian shore as allies and auxiliaries, while at the same time it was contesting Transoxiana with the Turks for the ground towards Chach. On the Byzantine side was the Eastern Roman Empire of Emperor Maurice, fielding the tagmata of the capital, the themed field armies of the provinces and the garrison of the Armenian theme, together with the host of the Armenian king Vahan and Iverian, Alan and Lazi contingents in Byzantine pay. Byzantium treated the whole war as a fight for survival on the Caucasian and Armenian borders: the object was to hold the Antioch line and the chain of fortresses strung across the mountain gaps above the upper Euphrates. For Persia it was a northward expansion to preserve the Transcaucasian buffer and suzerainty over Armenia. Both sides understood that losing the frontier cost more than losing a battle.
people: 拜占庭方面，這場戰爭有兩個人扛著。一是亞美尼亞王瓦罕·馬米科尼揚，靠拜占庭的金錢與伊比里亞盟友的援兵，在德溫與塞克胡克之間死守了數月，把波斯在亞美尼亞的攻勢拖成消耗戰；他是馬米科尼揚王朝的君主，也是拜占庭扶植的亞美尼亞王位人選。二是拜占庭將軍納爾塞斯，這位老將在查士丁尼時代就與薩珊打過拉茲戰爭，清楚在亞美尼亞山地用兵的分寸，591年那場決定性的反攻正是由他統率。薩珊方面最有影響力的名字是科斯勞二世：他在590年推翻自己的父親霍爾米茲德四世，卻選擇把戰爭打下去，把大軍推過幼發拉底河、圍困卡帕多細亞的堡壘，而不是趁亂退讓；前線主將是沙欣，他圍攻特拉比松約兩年未果，轉入內陸後終於在野戰中覆沒。北方還有薩珊大將納爾塞赫於590年起兵反叛，牽制了王都周邊的軍力；伊比里亞王國與高加索阿爾巴尼亞的首領，以及被雇用的阿蘭騎兵首領，則決定了誰能先把援兵送上高原。必須說明的是，關於此戰的細節幾乎全靠拜占庭方面的記錄，狄奧菲爾斯·西莫卡塔的編年史是主要來源，人名與數字在不同抄本之間常有出入。
peopleEn: On the Byzantine side two men carried the war. The first was the Armenian king Vahan Mamikonian, ruler of the Mamikonian dynasty and the candidate for the Armenian throne backed by Byzantium, who with Byzantine money and Iberian allies held Dvin and Sekhuk for months and turned the Persian offensive in Armenia into a war of attrition. The second was the Roman general Narses, an old commander who had already fought the Sasanians in the long Lazic war of Justinian's reign and knew the measure of campaigning in Armenian mountain country; the decisive counterstroke of 591 was his. On the Persian side the most consequential name was Khosrow II, who overthrew his own father Hormizd IV in 590 yet chose to continue the war, pushing the army across the Euphrates and onto the fortresses of Cappadocia instead of withdrawing while the throne was in confusion. His field commander was Shahin, who failed to take Trebizond after roughly two years of siege, turned inland, and was finally destroyed in open battle. In the north the Persian general Narseh rose against the throne in 590 and tied down troops around the capital, while the princes of Iberia and Caucasian Albania and the hired leaders of the Alan horse decided who could first bring reinforcements up onto the plateau. It must be said that the details of this war survive almost entirely on the Byzantine side, above all in the chronicle of Theophylact Simocatta, so names and figures differ between manuscripts and between the two traditions.
kits: 卡面上的科林斯青銅盔是公元前七世紀希臘的產物：全銅面甲只留兩道眼孔與一道鼻脊，正面開眼、背後無遮蔽，戴上之後看不見左右，轉頭全靠脖子的幅度；到公元588年，這種樣式早已退出一線野戰，古典式重裝步兵的戰列早已瓦解，這一點必須先講清楚。戰役現場真正戴在頭上的其實是兩套東西。拜占庭一方用五至六世紀常見的「脊盔」式鐵盔，以及披掛式護頸連到札甲胸甲的卡塔弗拉克托斯重裝騎兵，手持康托斯長矛與薩巴直刀，近身戰靠短劍與棍棒。薩珊一方的重甲騎兵頭戴伊朗式頭盔，前緣常垂下青銅或鎏金面甲與護頸相連，騎手配彎刀、圓盾與長矛；弓騎兵用複合弓與絲弦，弓臂修得極長，以便在馬背上張開，箭袋掛在腰側，奔射時不須減速。攻城一方薩珊備有攻城塔、撞錘與擲石砲，而且真的把戰象運到特拉比松前線，攻城象在拜占庭方面的記載裡造成極大的恐慌，拜占庭守軍屢次騷擾象隊的飼料與水源。科林斯青銅盔在這場戰爭裡的位置，是「被後世想像成重步兵的標誌」：它恰好量度出青銅面甲在六世紀高加索山地的無能為力——能撐住邊疆的是堡壘、弓弩、投射兵器與騎兵迂迴，而不是一整面青銅。
kitsEn: The Corinthian helmet on the card is a seventh-century BC Greek product: a full bronze face mask with only two eye-holes and a nose ridge, open to the front and unprotected behind, so that its wearer cannot see sideways and must turn the whole head. By 588 CE that pattern had long since left the first line, the hoplite phalanx of classical times had dissolved, and this must be stated plainly. What was actually worn on the head in this campaign were two other traditions. On the Byzantine side were the iron ridge helmets of the fifth and sixth centuries and the kataphraktoi, heavy cavalry whose mail aventail hung down over a lamellar cuirass and who carried the kontos lance and the spatha, fighting at close quarters with sword and club. On the Sasanian side the heavy cavalry wore Iranian helmets with a bronze or gilt face mask falling down in front and joined to an aventail, the rider carrying a curved sword, a round shield and a spear; the horse archers used composite bows with silk strings and a bow of exaggerated length so that it could be drawn from the saddle, with a quiver at the hip and no need to slow down while shooting. The Persian besiegers had siege towers, battering rams and stone-throwers, and they did bring war elephants to the line before Trebizond, whose appearance filled Byzantine accounts with panic and repeatedly drew attacks on the animals' fodder and water. The card's helmet still has a place in this war, but as the emblem of heavy infantry: it measures exactly how little a bronze face can do in the mountains of the Caucasus in the sixth century, where fortresses, bows, missile artillery and mounted manoeuvre decide the outcome, not masks.
tactics: 薩珊的戰法是薩珊式的：先用重裝騎兵與弓騎兵沿邊境快速推進，把拜占庭的邊堡逐個孤立，再用戰象與攻城塔把堡壘硬磨開，同時以分兵滲入亞美尼亞山道，試圖切斷君士坦丁堡與外省之間的聯繫。攻方的弱點在糧道——從呼羅珊與美索不達米亞運來的給養要翻越高加索與安納托利亞的長距離山道，冬季積雪與春季融雪都會把後方斷掉；而拜占庭守軍只要守住德溫、塞克胡克、特拉比松與卡帕多細亞的要塞群，就等於把戰爭變成對方糧食的消耗戰。拜占庭的反擊因此有清楚的次第：先讓精銳迂迴部隊在亞美尼亞東側的高地集結，等到波斯野戰軍深入、圍城部隊與主力拉開距離，才由納爾塞斯與瓦罕聯軍在山地會師，以步兵正面纏鬥、弓弩與投射兵器側翼覆蓋、輕騎繞到敵軍後方切斷退路，逼使波斯軍在缺糧的狀態下分批潰散。波斯方面在失利後的動作是全線收縮：放棄已經下沉的圍城部隊，退回幼發拉底河東岸，把損失控制在邊境線以內，雙方才坐下來談判。
tacticsEn: Persian method was Sasanian method. Heavy cavalry and horse archers first swept along the frontier, isolating one Byzantine border fort after another; war elephants and siege towers then ground the strongpoints open; and columns pushed into the Armenian passes to cut the road between Constantinople and the eastern provinces. The attacker's weakness lay in his supply line, for food and fodder had to be brought from Khurasan and Mesopotamia along the long mountain roads of the Caucasus and Anatolia, and both winter snow and the spring melt could break the rear of the column. The Byzantine defence turned on exactly this: so long as Dvin, Sekhuk, Trebizond and the fortresses of Cappadocia held, the war became a contest over the enemy's grain. The Byzantine counterstroke therefore followed a deliberate order. A picked force was concentrated in the highlands east of Armenia, and only when the Persian field army had gone deep and had drawn away from its own sieges did Narses and Vahan meet it in the mountains, locking infantry in frontal combat, covering the flanks with bows and missile artillery, and swinging light horse round the enemy rear to close the road of retreat, so that the Persian army dissolved in detachments, hungry and short of supply. After the defeat Persia's action was contraction along the whole front: invested garrisons were relieved, the army fell back east of the Euphrates, and the losses were kept inside the border line. Only then did the two sides sit down to talk.
data: 這場戰爭可核對的數字不多，而且互相矛盾，主要原因是史料幾乎全部來自拜占庭一方，數字常按戰爭需要誇張。年份方面，開戰通常記在587年，中文的戰爭列表標為588年，591年以和約收場；開戰的確切月份沒有留下記載，只能按春季出兵的慣例推定為五月前後。兵力方面，拜占庭編年史把波斯大軍寫成數十萬，現代學者多收窄到數萬量級，常見的估計是三萬至五萬人，其中相當一部分是北高加索與外高加索的盟軍與傭兵；拜占庭方面的反攻聯軍一般估在一萬至兩萬人，包含帝國野戰軍與亞美尼亞、伊比里亞、拉茲的部眾。攻城時間可以核對：特拉比松被圍約兩年仍未攻下，德溫的圍攻延續數月以上才陷落，可見薩珊的攻城配備足夠，卻不足以速決。距離上，軍隊在亞美尼亞高原與安納托利亞東境之間來回推進常以數百公里計，從君士坦丁堡到特拉比松的補給線超過一千公里，後方還要靠象群與騾隊翻山。最終和約的代價，史料記拜占庭向薩珊支付約三千磅黃金，亞美尼亞則依約分割。死傷數字沒有可靠記載，雙方史料都只報敵方損失。
dataEn: Few figures for this war can be checked, and those that exist contradict one another, chiefly because the sources are almost entirely Byzantine and their numbers were inflated to suit the argument. As to dates, the opening is usually placed in 587, the Chinese war list marks 588, and the war ended with a settlement in 591; the exact month of the outbreak was not recorded, so it can only be assumed from the normal season of campaigning, around May. On strength, the Byzantine chroniclers write of tens of thousands upon tens of thousands of enemies, while modern scholars narrow this to the tens of thousands, commonly three to five tens of thousands, a large share of them allies and auxiliaries from the northern Caucasus and Transcaucasia; the Byzantine counterstroke is generally estimated at ten to twenty thousand men, combining imperial field troops with Armenian, Iverian and Lazi contingents. On the sieges the record can be checked: Trebizond stood blockaded for about two years without falling, while the siege of Dvin ran for many months before the place was taken, which shows the Persian siege train was well equipped but never fast enough to force a decision. On distance, the armies moved repeatedly hundreds of kilometres across the Armenian plateau and the east of Anatolia, and the supply line from Constantinople to Trebizond ran for more than a thousand kilometres, with the rear carried over the passes on elephants and mule trains. The recorded cost of the final settlement is about three thousand pounds of gold paid by Byzantium to Persia, with Armenia to be partitioned. There is no reliable casualty figure; each tradition reports only the enemy's losses.
cause: 開戰有雙層原因。外層是薩珊對高加索與亞美尼亞的控制權：亞美尼亞王位繼承人之爭裡，摩里斯扶植馬米科尼揚家族的瓦罕，薩珊則支持自己的人選，把一場內部的王位糾紛變成兩個帝國的邊界爭端；拜占庭還長期接納亞美尼亞流亡者與反叛貴族，這些人成了亞美尼亞戰線上最難纏的守軍。內層是590年的波斯王位危機：霍爾米茲德四世被宮廷推翻後，薩珊一時混亂，北方突厥與阿爾巴尼亞方向的反叛相繼而起，邊境線上出現鬆動；但科斯勞二世選擇重新集結兵馬，把正在收縮的戰役再推向前線，因為讓步只會讓亞美尼亞與外高加索的附庸徹底倒向拜占庭，這對一個靠邊境附庸而不是靠上疆立國的帝國來說是不能承受的。據拜占庭方面的記載，薩珊使節在君士坦丁堡遭到扣押與受辱也被列為導火線之一；這類記述帶有外交修辭，難以獨立核實。這場戰爭因此不是單純的邊境衝突，而是兩個帝國在後古典時代爭奪一條同盟與信仰都不穩定的邊界。
causeEn: There were two layers to the outbreak. The outer layer was Sasanian control of the Caucasus and Armenia: in the dispute over the Armenian succession Maurice backed Vahan of the Mamikonians while Persia supported its own candidate, turning an internal dynastic quarrel into a frontier claim between two empires, and Byzantium had for years sheltered Armenian exiles and rebel nobles, who became the most tenacious defenders on the Armenian front. The inner layer was the Persian crisis of 590, when the overthrow of Hormizd IV left the state confused, with risings following one another in the Turkic and Albanian directions and the frontier line momentarily loose. Khosrow II nevertheless chose to refit his army and push the contracting war forward again, because concessions would have thrown Armenia and the Transcaucasian clients wholly into the Byzantine camp, and that was a price an empire resting on border clients rather than on its own provinces could not pay. Byzantine accounts also list the arrest and humiliation of Persian envoys in Constantinople among the causes of the war; such passages are diplomatic rhetoric and cannot be checked independently. The war was therefore not a simple border clash but an attempt by two empires to fix the fate of a frontier whose alliances and loyalties were never secure.
impact: 591年的和約改寫了高加索的版圖。亞美尼亞被切成兩半，西部連同關鍵堡壘歸拜占庭，東部留給薩珊，兩國在幼發拉底河上游、庫拉河與阿拉克斯河之間畫出一條長期反覆爭吵的界線，這條線在後來六個世紀裡一再被重新划過，亞美尼亞也從此成為兩大帝國之間反覆易手的緩衝地。對拜占庭而言，此役換來的是摩里斯政府的聲望，以及591年設立的亞美尼亞總督區，西部邊界從此多出一層緩衝，但代價是要付出一筆真金白銀的外交贖金。對薩珊而言，失敗的收穫不只是疆土的失去，還有「王位可以被宮廷推翻」這個已被證實的經驗；科斯勞二世此後把壓力轉向別處，兩年後拜占庭皇帝摩里斯被禁衛軍推翻，帝國陷入內亂，薩珊立刻利用這個空檔南下，於602年爆發全面戰爭，二十六年間把雙方都打到筋疲力盡，赫勒克勒斯幾乎淪為被追捕的亡命之徒。可以說，587至591年的失敗並沒有給波斯帶來安全，只是延後了下一輪衝突的到來。北線的變化同樣深遠：西突厥與哈扎爾在這一輪裡趁火打劫過一把，之後轉而與拜占庭接觸，這條路最終通向626年赫勒克勒斯與西突厥的聯手。
impactEn: The settlement of 591 redrew the map of the Caucasus. Armenia was cut in two, the west with its key fortresses passing to Byzantium and the east remaining with Persia, and the two empires drew a frontier between the upper Euphrates, the Kura and the Araxes that would be argued over again for six centuries, leaving Armenia as a buffer that changed hands repeatedly between the two great powers. For Byzantium the war bought the standing of Maurice's government and the creation in 591 of the Armenian exarchate, adding a buffer to the western border, at the price of a cash indemnity paid in diplomacy. For Persia the loss was not only territory but a demonstrated lesson, that a throne can be overturned by a palace. Khosrow II turned the pressure elsewhere; two years later Maurice was overthrown by his own guards, the empire fell into civil war, Persia seized the opening and the general war that began in 602 emptied both states over twenty-six years, driving Heraclius to the edge of destruction. The defeat of 587-591 therefore brought Persia no safety, only a postponement of the next collision. The northern front changed as well: the West Turks and the Khazars had probed the distracted Sasanians during this war, and afterwards turned towards Byzantium, a road that eventually led to Heraclius' alliance with the Turks in 626.
result: 結果是拜占庭的戰術勝利與薩珊的戰略收縮。591年，拜占庭與亞美尼亞聯軍在亞美尼亞高原北部擊潰波斯野戰軍，特拉比松與德溫一線的圍城解除，薩珊不得不把軍隊撤回邊境，談判隨即展開。雙方在591年達成的安排包括：拜占庭支付約三千磅黃金；亞美尼亞按約分割，西部歸拜占庭，東部仍由薩珊控制；邊界大致沿幼發拉底河上游與庫拉河、阿拉克斯河一線劃定，拜占庭承認薩珊在東亞美尼亞的宗主權，同時取得德溫以外的一批據點。對薩珊來說，這是一場得不償失的遠征：消耗了數萬兵力的遠征軍、多年的邊境戰與一筆還要再掏的贖金，換來的是對亞美尼亞鬆動的間接控制，以及一段被自己人記住的敗績。對拜占庭來說，勝利同樣有限：亞美尼亞只拿到一部分，薩珊的實力未被削弱，邊界線只推前了數百公里；真正的清算要等到三十年後那場規模遠大於此的戰爭。
resultEn: The result was a tactical victory for Byzantium and a strategic contraction for Persia. In 591 the combined Byzantine and Armenian army destroyed the Persian field force in the northern Armenian highlands, the sieges of Trebizond and Dvin were lifted, and the Sasanians had to withdraw to the border and open negotiations. The arrangement reached in 591 included a payment of about three thousand pounds of gold from Byzantium; a partition of Armenia, with the west going to Byzantium and the east remaining under Sasanian control; and a frontier drawn broadly along the upper Euphrates and the Kura and Araxes rivers, by which Byzantium acknowledged Sasanian suzerainty over eastern Armenia while gaining a number of strongpoints beyond Dvin. For Persia it was a bad expedition: an army of tens of thousands consumed, years of frontier war and an indemnity still to be paid, exchanged for a loosened indirect grip on Armenia and a defeat its own people remembered. For Byzantium the victory was equally limited: it took only part of Armenia, Sasanian strength was never broken, and the frontier moved forward by only a few hundred kilometres; the real reckoning came thirty years later, in a war of far greater scale.
